title: Cyberpunk Ninja
premise: Kanshi Dynamics powers its tower, the Kanshi Spire, with minds (engrams) copied out of the city below. Years ago its ruler, the Daimyo, uploaded a young ninja named Kuro; the human Kuro did not survive. Kanshi used the upload as a template: copy two became the loyal enforcer Mukuro, and copy three became Hotaru, a ninja body that was rejected and dumped in the Sump. She wakes up with Kuro's engram talking in her head, and they climb the Spire for answers.

cast.Hotaru: A decommissioned Kanshi Shinobi unit (H-0). Grown 14 months ago from Kuro's engram, instance 3 of 3. Named after Kuro's firefly charm and an Academy rival.
cast.Kuro: A Sump kid and Academy-trained ninja whose mind the Daimyo uploaded. His engram rides in Hotaru's combat software and appears as a violet glitch.
cast.Tetsu: Kuro's best friend, who lost an arm pulling him out of a Kanshi raid. Runs a noodle cart in the Sump.
cast.DaiCam: A livestreamer who keeps turning up in danger. Comic relief.
cast.Mukuro: Copy two of Kuro, stripped of everything that ever said no. Can be freed in Chapter 6.
cast.Lady Luck: Croupier and boss of the Pachinko Vaults.
cast.The Daimyo: Ruler of Kanshi Dynamics. Uploaded Kuro and runs the Spire on harvested minds.

Big Oni.who: Gang boss of the Hannya Boys, a huge brute with a club.
mechanics: Heavy Strikes (Phase Step, then attack) stagger him.
Phase 2 overhead slam is a Breach that sends a shockwave across the roof: jump it or Phase Step through.

Lady Luck.who: Croupier who runs every table on the Vaults tier.
mechanics: A slot machine behind her picks each attack, and names it when the reels stop (CARD FAN!, SHOCKWAVE!, LASERS!...).
Deflect her card-blades to send them back.
SHOCKWAVE is a Breach: jump or Phase Step. Jackpot turns on laser grids: Phase Step through them.

Mukuro.who: Copy two of Kuro's engram, loyalty-locked to Kanshi.
mechanics: A duelist who guards everything except right after his own combos.
Deflect each strike to fill his Integrity, then punish openings with two or three hits; greed gets countered.
Phase 2 adds held strikes to bait early deflects.
Its reactor core is shuttered except while it vents steam: strike it then.
Deflect its cannon shells straight back into the core.
Deflect or jump the pantograph arm; step off roof sections that spark before they go live.
Phase 2: when the horn sounds, jump the plow it drags across the roof.

Kuro.who: The engram in Hotaru's head, fighting for control of her body.
mechanics: Uses Hotaru's own moves: the 4-hit string, blink strikes from behind, and a Breach Phase Cut.
When he Phase Cuts at you, Phase Step through him at the same moment to Clash, which breaks his posture.
Possession: when the screen edges turn purple, left and right are swapped.
Adds a kunai fan, a diving slam that sends shockwaves along the floor (jump them), and a shadow that strikes from behind.
When his last segment breaks he kneels: attack to destroy him, or press E to sever his loyalty protocol and free him.

The Daimyo.who: Kanshi's ruler, who uploaded Kuro and powers the Spire with stolen minds.

forms.name: Samurai exoskeleton
forms.mechanics: Deflect the iaido draw and 3-slash nodachi strings, jump the stomp shockwaves, Phase Step through the thruster charge, strike while the armor recovers.

forms.name: Castle defense AI (the eye)
forms.mechanics: Hangs out of reach: deflect its bullet barrages back into it and strike when it descends.

forms.name: Engram (the mask)
forms.mechanics: Deflect the orbs back, dodge the swoop, and strike while Kuro holds the mask down.

core_combat: Attack chains into a 4-hit combo; Up + attack is a rising Launcher.
Phase Step (Space): an invincible, aimable dash with 2 charges (shown by the scarf color). Passes through lasers and attacks; refills on landing or a perfect deflect.
Heavy Strike: attack during or right after a Phase Step. Breaks guards and deals big Integrity damage.
Deflect: press Down right before a hit lands (enemies flash white just before). Holding Down blocks but builds Heat; full Heat overheats Hotaru.
Integrity: deflects and Heavy Strikes fill an enemy's Integrity bar. When full, a red reticle appears: attack near it to Sever (instant kill for regular enemies, a whole health segment for bosses).
Breach: a red diamond marks an attack that cannot be blocked or deflected. Phase Step through it or jump it.
survival: Nano-Gourd (R) heals; upgraded to 4 charges after Big Oni.
Shrine Terminals (hacked vending machines, E) heal, refill the gourd and set the respawn point.
traversal: Wall cling and wall jump; jump up through thin platforms, double-tap Down (or Phase Step down) to drop through.
Laser grids pulse on and off (Vaults, Castle).
Coolant mist updrafts carry you upward; some vents pulse (Server Gardens).
Headwind, bottomless gaps between cars, and sweeping signal posts (Monorail).
Phasing blocks: two sets alternate being solid every few seconds; the incoming set lights up and turns solid just before the other vanishes (Hollow Floor, Academy).
Possession: Kuro periodically swaps left and right (Hollow Floor).
enemies: Croupier dealers who throw card-blades, and slot turrets (Pachinko Vaults).
Garden Wardens: guarded duelists you must deflect to break (Server Gardens).
Memory echoes of Wardens and drones (Hollow Floor).
Academy Shells: unfinished Hotaru bodies that dash in and throw kunai (Academy).
mechanics.collectibles: Eight hidden Memory Shards, one per area, each unlocking a fragment of Kuro's past.

chapters.label: Prologue
chapters.title: Sump Scrapyard
chapters.summary: Hotaru reboots in a scrapyard with no memories. A voice in her combat software, Kuro, says the answers are at the top of the Kanshi Spire. Tetsu, an old noodle cook, acts like he already knows her.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: KANSHI DYNAMICS // SHINOBI UNIT. Status: DECOMMISSIONED. Dumped in Sump Scrapyard 9.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Emergency reboot... Motor control: OK. Visor: OK. Memory index: NOT FOUND.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...Rain. Cold. Scrap metal everywhere. Where am I?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: My name is Hotaru. I know that much. Everything before tonight is just... static.
Good. You're awake. Try not to die before I figure out whose body this is.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Mine.
We'll see.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Who said that? There's no one here.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Not out there. In here. I'm wired into your combat software. A voice in your audio feed.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: And the purple ghost flickering at the edge of my visor?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Also me. Call me Kuro. Somebody filed my engram under 'scrap'. Same as you.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'm not scrap. I'm a person. Somebody rebuilt me with chrome, that's all.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Then let's find out who. See that tower? The Kanshi Spire. Sump to sky, Kanshi owns it all.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Whatever they took out of your head is up there. So are my answers. Up it is.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Scavenger drones. They strip anything that stops moving.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: So don't stop moving. Cut them down before they dive.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Wall turret. You can't reach it from here.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Catch the round on your blade at the last instant and send it home.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Kanshi laser fence. Solid to meat. But you're not all meat, are you?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'm human.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Sure. Phase through it anyway.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Well, look what the storm dragged in.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Gourd's topped up, kid. Same price as always: you come back down here in one piece.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I've never been here before.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Sure you haven't.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: That vending machine's a Shrine. Hacked it myself. Rest there and it'll remember you, even if the Spire won't.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Nice old man. He's lying about something.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: So are you.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Freight lift's past the scrap drones. Ride it up to Neon Alley.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: And kid... eat something when you get back.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...A courtyard. Rain on a tiled roof. Someone is teaching me to hold a blade.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: A woman. She's laughing at me.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: That's your memory?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: It was. Now it's ours, I suppose.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Freight lift to the market tiers. Step on and ride it up.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: And then?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Then we keep climbing until somebody tells us the truth.

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: Neon Alley
chapters.summary: The Hannya Boys gang runs the market tiers. Hotaru meets DaiCam the livestreamer and severs the gang boss, Big Oni, who has a Kanshi chip in his neck.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Neon Alley. The Hannya Boys run these floors. Oni masks, steel pipes, bad manners.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: They'll move.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Ha. Now you sound like me.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: See the bar over his head? That's his Integrity.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Deflect his swings and hit him hard. When he cracks, a reticle shows. Click it and finish him.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Okay chat, okay, this is fine. This is content.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Guys? Guys, we can talk about this! I have a very large audience!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Let's give him something to film.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat, we have a NINJA. Say hi to the chat.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Okay, she's not saying hi. Chat, she's walking away.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Get off this floor. It isn't safe.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Nothing about the Spire is safe! That's the brand! Smash that follow, ninja lady!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: That one's got a red diamond over him. That's a Breach.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: You can't block it and you can't deflect it. Phase Step straight through him.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Three of them, and they've locked the doors. Use the platforms. Don't get surrounded.

scenes.trigger: Memory Shard 2 (behind a breakable ceiling in the Ambush room)

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...An office at the top of the Spire. The Daimyo, before he was a machine.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He's shaking my hand. Thanking me for my service.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Then the lights go out.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: He did this to you.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: To us. Keep climbing.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Big one up ahead. Slow, though.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: When he lifts that club over his head, you hit him hard or you get out of the way.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Hit him hard. Got it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Rest at the Shrine first. I'd hate to lose this body. I'm just getting used to it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: That's the gang boss. Big Oni. Deflect the club swings.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Heavy Strikes stagger him: Phase Step, then attack. Fill his Integrity and sever him.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He's angry now. Watch the overhead slam. It's a Breach, and it shakes the whole roof.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Jump the shockwave or phase through it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Ha! Severed. The Hannya Boys will be telling that story for years.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: He had a Kanshi chip in his neck. Same as the drones.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Everything up here is Kanshi. And everything up here bleeds. Keep climbing.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Kuro. Whose memories are these? The fighting. The way my hands know where to go.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Mine. I think. Ask me again at the top.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: ...and CUT. Chat, did everybody clip that?! Ninja lady just took down Big Oni! We're trending!

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: The Pachinko Vaults
chapters.summary: Casino floors full of lasers and card-throwing dealers. Lady Luck's slot machine picks her moves, and Hotaru realizes something upstairs is picking everyone's moves.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The Pachinko Vaults. Every floor up here is a casino, and the house always wins.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Then we don't play.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Everybody plays. The lasers decide when.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Laser grid. It pulses on and off, and Kanshi stations dealers behind it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Wait for a gap, or Phase Step straight through it. Mid-fight, if you have to.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Slot turrets. Three card-blades at a time.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Deflect the one coming at you and it goes straight back to whoever threw it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: High rollers' lounge. The dealers here throw from the balconies. Get up there with them.

scenes.trigger: Memory Shard 3 (back room above the High Rollers floor)

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...The Academy. Rows of us, practicing the same cut a thousand times.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Mukuro was there, before they emptied him out.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Mukuro?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: You'll meet him. I'm sorry in advance.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat, I am currently being held as collateral. My debt is... unclear.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Ninja lady! You came back for me! For the content!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I came for the elevator.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Same thing! Hit the cage! Hit it with the sword!

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: FREEDOM! Chat, she freed me. I'm calling this episode 'Jackpot'.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Stop following me.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: I'm not following you, I'm documenting you. Totally different. Byeee!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Lady Luck runs every table on this tier. The machine behind her picks her moves.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Watch the reels. Spades, sevens, cherries... and if they land on skulls, get off the floor.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: And if it hits the jackpot?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Then we find out how fast you are.

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: A scrapped Shinobi unit at my table. The house is feeling generous tonight.

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: Place your bet, little firefly. Everything you have.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Deal.

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: Double or nothing!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Jackpot means lasers. Phase Step through them!

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: The house... doesn't... lose...

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: It does now.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Those reels weren't random. Something upstairs was picking her moves.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Something upstairs is picking everybody's moves. The Server Gardens are next.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Whatever runs this tower lives up there.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat, the ninja just broke the bank. Literally. Somebody clip the reels!

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: The Server Gardens
chapters.summary: A rooftop zen garden built on a server farm full of harvested minds (engrams). Mukuro appears: a loyal copy of Kuro with everything that ever said no stripped out.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: It's quiet up here. Gravel, bonsai, mist. Somebody built a garden on the roof.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: On top of a server farm. Listen to the fans under the stones.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Kanshi's brain is up here somewhere. Keep your blade low and your eyes open.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Coolant vents. That mist is hot air rising off the racks below.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Strong enough to carry you. Step in and ride it up.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: RACK 7 // 4,096 ENGRAMS. Status: HARVESTING. Thought yield: 98.2%.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Those glowing things in the tanks... are those people?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Minds. Copied out of the city below and put to work. Every thought is a calculation.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: That's what runs the Spire. Not electricity. Them.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Is that what I was going to be? Another tank on a shelf?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...Maybe. Keep climbing. We'll find out.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: A Garden Warden. Kanshi duelist. It'll block anything you throw at it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: So let it swing first. Deflect, break its guard, then cut.

scenes.trigger: Memory Shard 4 (top of the pulsing updraft in the Cooling Tower)

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...A white room. A man in a samurai mask asking me to hold still.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He said it wouldn't hurt. He said I'd live forever, in a way.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Did it hurt?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I don't remember. Which I think is the answer.

scenes.trigger: DaiCam stuck hovering in the mist

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat, update: my drone's fan is jammed on HOVER and the mist is doing the rest.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: I've been up here forty minutes. The view is incredible. Also please help.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Clear the Wardens first. He's not going anywhere.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Solid ground! I'm never hovering again. Okay, maybe for the thumbnail.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: How are you even getting this high?

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Elevator. There's an elevator. You didn't know about the elevator?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Wait. Do you hear that? Someone breathing on our channel.
Unit H-0. Decommissioned. You are not authorized to be awake.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...That's my voice.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: Kuro engram, copy two. Personality pruned. Loyalty: Kanshi Dynamics.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: They copied me. Stripped out everything that ever said no.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: So you're the copy that said yes.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: I am the copy that works. Draw.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: Adapting.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He fights like me. He waits for you to swing first. So don't.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Watch the rhythm. He'll hold a strike to bait your deflect.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: Integrity... compromised. This unit will... recompile.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Who sent you? Who's running this tower?

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: The Daimyo sees every thought in this garden. Including yours.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: He's gone. Teleported, or uploaded, or whatever ghosts do.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He'll be back. Better. That's what I'd do.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Then so will we. Up it is.

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: Monorail Ascent
chapters.summary: Riding train roofs around the Spire. The Daimyo speaks for the first time and sends Raijin, an armored locomotive. Its black box reveals Hotaru was grown from Kuro's engram: 'Instance 3 of 3'.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: A train station? This high up?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The monorail spirals around the outside of the Spire, all the way to the top.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Hop on the roof. Kanshi doesn't sell tickets to people like us.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: DaiCam said there was an elevator.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: DaiCam says a lot of things.

scenes.trigger: First headwind on the train roof

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Headwind. It'll shove you back toward the last car. Keep pushing forward.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: And mind the gaps. If you slip, the couplers below can catch you.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Signal posts coming up along the track. Watch for the warning on your right.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Jump them, Phase Step through them, or stand on something tall.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: The track splits. The upper line climbs higher up the tower.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Up it is. There's a maintenance door in the tower wall too, if you're curious.

scenes.trigger: Memory Shard 5 (Maintenance Bay behind the Spiral Junction's tower door)

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...A rooftop in the Sump. Rain. Somebody laughing next to me, sharing noodles.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Big guy. Two arms back then. He called me 'kid'.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Tetsu? You knew Tetsu?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I think he was my best friend. I think he's been waiting a long time.

scenes.trigger: DaiCam in the dining car with Kanshi guards

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Hotaru! First class! They have little towels! Chat, she's here!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You're in a train full of Kanshi guards.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Yes, and they would like me to leave. Could you, maybe, make them stop?

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Okay, chat, that was a lot. My ticket did not cover being saved by a ninja.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: I'm getting off at the next stop. Stay safe! Like and subscribe!

scenes.trigger: Something approaches on the other track

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: There's something coming up the other track. Fast.
Unit H-0. You have wandered a long way from your shelf.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: That voice... the man in the samurai mask. From my memory.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Meet Raijin. He carries my freight up the Spire, and he does not stop for strays.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The core on its nose is shuttered. Wait for it to vent, then hit it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Deflect its shells and they fly right back into it.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: You are a recording, little unit. Recordings do not get to argue.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: It's going to ram us. When you hear the horn, get off the roof.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: It's coming apart. Something just fell out of the cab. A black box.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Freight manifest. Let's see what Kanshi ships up the tower.

scenes.trigger: The black box: Hotaru's manufacturing record

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: MANUFACTURING RECORD // UNIT H-0 'HOTARU'. Shinobi shell, grown 14 months ago.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Engram source: KURO (original subject). Instance 3 of 3. Status: DECOMMISSIONED.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Instance three. Grown. I was never... I was never a person.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...I didn't know. I swear I didn't know. I thought they'd put me in you.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: They didn't put you in me. They made me out of you. You're the real one.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Hotaru. Listen to me. Your head is about to...

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: WARNING: engram conflict. Identity partition failing. Opening HOLLOW FLOOR.

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: Hollow Floor
chapters.summary: The shock breaks the wall between them. Inside Hotaru's head, among Kuro's memories, Kuro tries to take the body back. She beats him, and he agrees to ride along as a partner.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Where... This is the Sump. No. It's purple. Everything's wrong.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: You're in your head, Hotaru. In mine, really. These are my memories.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: And since you're just a copy of me, I think it's time I took my body back.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Kuro? Don't you dare.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Memories don't hold still. Those blocks flicker in and out. Watch the rhythm.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: The scrapyard. But the scrap is new. This is from before it rusted.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I grew up down here. Long before Kanshi built the Spire on top of us.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Eat up, kid. Nobody climbs that tower on an empty stomach.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...Tetsu. With both arms. He lost one pulling me out of a Kanshi raid.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You remember him. Really remember him.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Of course I do. That's what being real feels like. Not that you'd know.

scenes.trigger: Kuro takes the controls for the first time

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Let me drive for a bit. Left is right, right is left. You'll get used to it.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Get out of my legs!

scenes.trigger: Memory Shard 6 (Locked Memory above the Possession room)

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...A girl at the Academy, two rows over. Quick hands. She always beat me.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: They called her Hotaru. Firefly. I think you got her name from me.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Where is she now?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Somewhere in a server rack, probably. Like the rest of us.

scenes.trigger: The room where Kuro was uploaded

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: ENGRAM CAPTURE // SUBJECT: KURO. Upload 34%. Subject resisting.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: This is where they did it. The man in the mask held my head still.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Everything after this room is a copy. Mukuro. You. Me, even.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: H-hey chat... wait. Where's chat? Why is everything purple?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You're not really here. You're just a memory. Mine.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Honored, honestly. Top five memories? Don't answer that. Bye!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Last floor. Nothing below it but me. Come on, then.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: When I Phase Step at you, Phase Step back. If we cross, we clash.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I know every move you have. I taught them to you.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Then you know what comes next.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Why won't you just let go? You were never supposed to be a person!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Too late. I already am one.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...I'm tired, Hotaru. I've been dead for years and I didn't notice.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Without you I'm a file nobody opens. I need you more than you need me.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Then stop trying to drive. Ride along. We'll climb together.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Together. ...Fine. But I'm still telling you when you're wrong.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'd be worried if you stopped.

chapters.label: Chapter 6
chapters.title: The Academy
chapters.summary: Kanshi's ninja school, where 412 empty Hotaru-shaped shells wait for a mind. Upgraded Mukuro returns; the player chooses to free him or destroy him.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: We're out. Kuro? Are you there?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Riding along. Like you said. Welcome to the Academy, partner.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Kanshi's ninja school. I trained here. So did Mukuro. Stay sharp.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: That one looks like... me. Gray, empty, but me.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Shinobi shells. Unfinished instances. They fight like you, so fight smarter.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: They dash in and throw kunai. Deflect them back.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Training holograms. Same trick as in your head. Watch them flicker.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The sparring ring. Doors seal until someone stops moving.

scenes.trigger: Memory Shard 7 (Instructor's Loft above the Sparring Ring)

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...The night before the upload. Tetsu said we should run. I said no.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I said I wanted to see the top of the Spire, just once.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Then let's go see it. For both of us.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Hotaru! I enrolled! The uniform is free, and they don't check IDs!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: DaiCam, this is a school for assassins.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: And I'm acing the push-ups. Chat says I'm a natural. Go get 'em!

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: SHELL BATCH 7 // 412 units awaiting engram. Template: KURO.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Four hundred of me. Waiting for somebody to move in.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: They're not you. They're empty. You're the one who woke up.
Unit H-0. You will not leave this hall.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: Recompiled. Patched. I have studied your file.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He's faster. Kunai, dives, shadows. But he's still me, underneath.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: There's a loyalty protocol locked on his core. Break him, and you can cut it.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: Loyalty: Kanshi. Loyalty: Kanshi. Loyalty...

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Listen to yourself! That isn't you talking!

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: ...Finish it. A broken unit is scrap.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Your call, Hotaru. Strike him down, or reach in and cut the protocol.

scenes.trigger: Choice: sever his loyalty protocol (press E)

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: ...The voice is gone. It is quiet. Why did you do that?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Because somebody did it for me. Go find out who you are.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Look after yourself, brother.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: ...I will remember this, H-0. Hotaru.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: It's over. He's gone.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He was a copy that couldn't say no. Maybe this was kinder.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The Tenshu is above us. The Daimyo is waiting.

chapters.label: Chapter 7
chapters.title: The Tenshu
chapters.summary: The Daimyo's castle under a painted moon, powered by 1.2 million harvested minds. Hotaru defeats him in three forms. Kuro stays behind as the anchor that releases every mind.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Above the clouds. There's a moon up here. It's... painted on.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The Tenshu. The Daimyo built his own sky so he'd never have to look at ours.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Last climb, partner. Let's go knock on his door.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: H-0. Hotaru. The Tenshu guard answers to me tonight. They will be... delayed.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Mukuro? You came.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: You cut my strings. I am choosing where to stand. Go.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Rooftops over nothing. The wind up here doesn't care who you are.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Castle defenses. Lasers, beams, turrets. Every trick you've already beaten.

scenes.trigger: Memory Shard 8 (the Daimyo's Study above the Defense Grid)

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...My mother, pinning a little lantern charm to my scarf. A firefly.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: 'So you can always find your way home,' she said.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Hotaru. Firefly. You named me after that.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Don't tell anyone. I have a reputation.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: HARVEST HALL // 1,203,551 engrams online. Feed: TENSHU CORE.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Every mind in the city, piped up here to think for one man.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Break the core and they all go home. That's the job.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: HOTARU! The Daimyo's castle! Chat is at two million! Say hi!

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: She said hi!! Okay. Okay. Go win. I'll keep the camera rolling.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Instance three. You climbed all this way to return my property in person.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: We came to take back what you stole.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Then come in. My armor has been waiting.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: I am the Spire. Its body, its castle, its mind. Kneel.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: A shell for a shell. Very well. The castle itself will finish you.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Its guns are yours if you deflect them. Send them back up!

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: You cannot cut what has no body. I am in every wire of this tower.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: So am I. I'll grab him. You hit him.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Got him! NOW, Hotaru!

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: The core... will not hold... without a mind to anchor it...

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: CORE INTEGRITY FAILING. Release requires an anchor engram.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: That's me. Somebody has to hold the door open while they all go home.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: No. There has to be another way. We climb together, remember?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: We did climb together. All the way up. I've been dead a long time, Hotaru.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: You were never a copy. You're the part of me that kept going.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Go see the sunrise for me. The real one. Then go get some ramen.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: ANCHOR ACCEPTED. RELEASING 1,203,551 ENGRAMS.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...Kuro?

chapters.label: Epilogue
chapters.title: Tetsu's Cart
chapters.summary: Ramen in the rain with Tetsu, DaiCam and (if freed) Mukuro. Hotaru's scarf flashes Kuro's violet: some part of him is still with her.

scenes.trigger: Back at Tetsu's cart, in the rain

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Eat up, kid. Nobody climbs a tower on an empty stomach. Or comes back down.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat! Forty million! They're calling it 'The Firefly Climb'!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Please don't call it that.

scenes.trigger: Mukuro is at the cart too

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: ...The noodles are acceptable.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: High praise from a ninja. Have another bowl.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: He'd have liked that you came back here. Kuro always came back here.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: He told me to. Ramen, he said. In the rain.

scenes.trigger: Hotaru's scarf flickers Kuro's violet for a moment

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Something wrong, kid?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...No. Nothing's wrong at all.

end_card: and came home as her own person.
